baseline_role: FIBRE Broad Core owns candidate generation and general ranking; it is not an expert.

functional_foundation.runtime_support: broad shared query 128/128 candidates supported in smoke
functional_foundation.note: support/ranking authority will be decided at type-level ablation; no new fusion weight fitted here

structural_geometry.runtime_support: broad shared query 107/128 candidates supported in smoke

mechanistic.runtime_support: broad shared query 128/128 candidates supported in smoke

family_domain.runtime_support: P450 native smoke query 128/128 supported only by P450 member; phosphatase/terpene/TPS correctly unavailable
family_domain.note: family-finetuned EnzymeCAGE models are experts, never general-baseline comparators

contextual_observational.runtime_support: seed/homology smoke query 128/128 candidates supported when seed context is supplied

aggregation_contract.type_aggregation: mean over available standardized member scores
aggregation_contract.missing_policy: unavailable evidence contributes no type score; other types are not renormalized

ablation.policy: one fixed unified R2E test set only; five type-level leave-one-type-out switches plus core-only/all-types; no concrete-expert ablation
ablation.dataset_design: to be frozen after expert completion; use one uniform Broad candidate universe and a compact stratified query set that contains general, family-domain, and context-bearing queries
